perfRerun.note: Staging re-run with raised concurrency (Phase 5 standing checklist item). First raised attempt (40/90 VUs) repeatedly terminated the sandbox development server; root cause found and fixed: the 1024 file-descriptor limit - with ulimit 8192 the raised profiles run clean at 0% errors. Production hosting must provision file descriptors accordingly (recorded as an operations-manual provisioning item).

verification.console: P8 tab verified in Amharic, English and Afan Oromo and at 390px mobile width; no page errors.

defects.title: Staging perf re-run at raised concurrency (40/90 VUs) killed the sandbox dev server - environment file-descriptor ceiling (1024), not an application fault
defects.fix: Server restarted with ulimit 8192; raised profiles re-run clean at 0% errors (p95 1157 ms at 40 VUs, 2499 ms at 90 VUs). File-descriptor provisioning added to the operations manual and hosting checklist.

defects.title: Configuration freeze versions collided when re-freezing on the same day at the same item count (unique-constraint failure)
defects.fix: Freeze versions now carry date + sequence + random suffix; governed re-freeze drill passes; battery green at 161 pass / 0 fail.
